faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Got questions? We've got answers. Learn more about how IdleForest works and what to expect.
faq.install_q: How do I install and use the extension?
faq.permission_q: Why does the extension ask for 'read and change all data on all pages' permission?
faq.permission_a1: We understand this permission sounds broader than expected. Here's what's actually happening: We don't read or access any data from the websites you visit.
faq.permission_a2: Instead, the extension uses your unused bandwidth by fetching websites in a sessionless manner, ensuring no personal data is transmitted. This operates in complete isolation and doesn't have access to the page's content or your browsing data.
faq.permission_a3: The reason we need this broad permission is a technical limitation of how browser extensions work. To enable this functionality on any page, we need the permission that allows content injection. Unfortunately, browsers don't offer a more granular permission option—it's bundled under the "read and change" category, even though we're only using the injection capability.
faq.permission_a4: Your privacy and security are important to us. We're committed to only using the minimum functionality necessary to make the extension work.
faq.permission_a5: The good news is that our code is open source, so you don't have to take our word for it. You can review the code yourself to verify our claims. Learn more about
faq.safe_a1: Yes! IdleForest is completely safe. We use industry-standard security practices and our code is open source for full transparency.
faq.safe_a2: Your unused bandwidth is only used for approved research and content delivery purposes. We never access your personal data, browsing history, or any sensitive information.
faq.safe_a3: For complete details about who uses your bandwidth and how we protect you legally, visit our
faq.slow_q: Will this slow down my internet?
faq.slow_a1: No. IdleForest only uses your idle bandwidth—the internet capacity you're not actively using.
faq.slow_a2: Our extension is designed to have zero impact on your browsing experience. If you're streaming, gaming, or doing anything that requires bandwidth, IdleForest automatically scales back to ensure your activities aren't affected.
faq.trees_a1: When you use IdleForest, your shared bandwidth generates revenue. We use 100% of our profits to fund verified tree planting projects around the world.
faq.trees_a2: We partner with established organizations like Trees for the Future and Tree-Nation to ensure every tree is planted, tracked, and contributes to real environmental impact. You can track your personal contribution in real-time through your dashboard.
faq.browser_q: Do I need to keep my browser open?
faq.browser_a1: For the browser extension, yes—your browser needs to be open for IdleForest to work.
faq.browser_a2: However, we also offer desktop applications for Windows and macOS that run in the background even when your browser is closed. This allows you to maximize your impact without changing your daily routine.
faq.ai_q: I'm concerned about supporting AI companies. Why should I use IdleForest?
faq.ai_a1: We understand this concern. Here's the reality: AI companies will collect web data regardless—it's essential for training models and powering applications.
faq.ai_a2: The question isn't whether data collection happens, but how. Traditional web scraping uses massive data centers that consume enormous amounts of electricity and water. These server farms are responsible for 1-2% of global electricity consumption.
faq.ai_a3: Distributed networks like the one we use are 80-90% more environmentally friendly than traditional data centers. They use existing devices and idle bandwidth instead of dedicated servers running 24/7 with intensive cooling systems.
faq.ai_a4: By using IdleForest, you're not enabling something new—you're helping make an existing industry significantly greener while funding reforestation. It's harm reduction that creates positive environmental impact.
faq.ai_link: Learn more about the environmental benefits
faq.disclaimer: IdleForest is a browser extension and desktop app for reforestation. Not associated with the "Idle Forest" mobile game.

Transparency.hero_desc: We believe in complete transparency. Here's exactly who uses your idle bandwidth, what they do with it, and the legal protections we provide.
Transparency.env_desc: Yes, companies need data. But how they get that data matters for the environment. Distributed networks like Olostep are significantly more eco-friendly than traditional data centers.
Transparency.dc_energy: Massive energy consumption: Data centers use 1-2% of global electricity
Transparency.dc_cooling: 24/7 cooling systems: Up to 40% of energy goes to cooling alone
Transparency.dc_infra: Dedicated infrastructure: Servers running solely for web scraping
Transparency.dc_water: Water usage: Millions of gallons per day for cooling
Transparency.dn_infra: Zero new infrastructure: Uses existing devices already running
Transparency.dn_cooling: No additional cooling: Devices use ambient cooling
Transparency.dn_idle: Idle resource utilization: Bandwidth that would otherwise be wasted
Transparency.dn_water: No water consumption: Zero dedicated cooling infrastructure
Transparency.energy_desc: No dedicated servers or cooling infrastructure needed
Transparency.bottom_line_desc: Modern systems rely on web data. With IdleForest, we reduce the costs of traditional data center systems by 80–90% through distributed networks like Olostep, then plant more trees than needed to offset the remaining footprint—making the entire process net negative.
Transparency.client_desc: We work exclusively with one vetted partner to ensure the highest standards of security and ethical use.
Transparency.what_olostep_does_desc: Olostep provides a web data API that helps companies and developers access clean, structured web data. They fetch publicly available information from websites to power applications, research tools, and business intelligence platforms.
Transparency.how_bandwidth_desc: Your idle bandwidth is used to fetch publicly accessible websites in a sessionless manner, ensuring no personal data is transmitted. This means:
Transparency.no_cookies: No cookies, login credentials, or personal information are ever sent
Transparency.public_only: Only publicly available web pages are accessed (the same content anyone can see)
Transparency.isolated: Requests are isolated from your browsing session and personal data
Transparency.ip_usage: Your IP address is used only to make standard web requests, similar to normal browsing
Transparency.who_uses_desc: Olostep serves legitimate AI startups and technology companies. Here are some of their verified customers:
Transparency.who_uses_note: These companies use Olostep to power AI research, lead generation, market analysis, and other legitimate business intelligence applications.
Transparency.searches_title: What Types of Searches Are Performed
Transparency.bi_desc: Gathering publicly available company information, contact details, and market data for sales and research purposes.
Transparency.price_desc: Tracking product prices across e-commerce websites to help businesses stay competitive and consumers find the best deals.
Transparency.research_desc: AI powered deep research for healthcare, pharma and financial industries.
Transparency.content_desc: Tracking changes to websites, job postings, news articles, and other public content for business and research purposes.
Transparency.dont_illegal: Perform illegal activities or access restricted websites
Transparency.dont_spam: Send spam, conduct DDoS attacks, or engage in malicious behavior
Transparency.dont_personal: Access or transmit your personal data, cookies, or login credentials
Transparency.dont_tos: Violate website terms of service or engage in unauthorized scraping
Transparency.legal_desc: We take your legal protection seriously. Here are the safeguards in place to protect you.
Transparency.liability_desc: IdleForest assumes full legal responsibility for all traffic generated through our network. Our Terms of Service explicitly state that:
Transparency.liability_1: You are not liable for the content or nature of requests made through your connection
Transparency.liability_2: IdleForest indemnifies users against any legal claims arising from network usage
Transparency.liability_3: We maintain comprehensive liability insurance to cover potential legal issues
Transparency.vetting_desc: We only work with Olostep, a legitimate business that has been thoroughly vetted:
Transparency.vetting_1: Olostep is a registered company with verified business credentials
Transparency.vetting_2: Their use cases are limited to legitimate web data collection for AI and business intelligence
Transparency.vetting_3: We have a legal agreement that prohibits illegal activities and ensures compliance with all applicable laws
Transparency.vetting_4: Olostep's code is open source and can be audited for security and compliance
Transparency.monitoring_desc: We actively monitor all network traffic to ensure compliance:
Transparency.monitoring_1: Automated systems flag suspicious or unauthorized traffic patterns
Transparency.monitoring_2: All requests are logged and can be audited if needed
Transparency.monitoring_3: We maintain a blocklist of prohibited websites and activities
Transparency.monitoring_4: Any violation of our acceptable use policy results in immediate termination of the client relationship
Transparency.gdpr_desc: As a European-based service, we comply with GDPR and other data protection regulations:
Transparency.gdpr_1: No personal data is collected, stored, or transmitted through the network
Transparency.gdpr_2: All web requests are sessionless and isolated from your personal browsing
Transparency.gdpr_3: You can opt out at any time by uninstalling the extension or desktop app
Transparency.gdpr_4: We maintain detailed privacy policies and data processing agreements
Transparency.encrypted_desc: All traffic is encrypted using industry-standard TLS/SSL protocols to prevent interception or tampering.
Transparency.isolated_desc: Requests run in isolated environments with no access to your cookies, local storage, or browsing history.
Transparency.logging_desc: All network activity is logged and available for your review. You can see exactly what requests are being made.
Transparency.opensource_desc: Our extension and desktop app are open source, allowing independent security researchers to audit our code.
Transparency.bandwidth_desc: You have full control over how much bandwidth is used. Set limits or pause sharing at any time.
Transparency.optout_desc: You can stop sharing your bandwidth immediately by pausing or uninstalling the app—no questions asked.
Transparency.faq_see_q: Can I see what websites are being accessed through my connection?
Transparency.faq_see_a: Yes! We're working on a transparency dashboard that will show you anonymized statistics about the types of requests being made. In the meantime, you can review our open-source code to see exactly how the system works.
Transparency.faq_harmful_q: What if Olostep's customers use the data for harmful purposes?
Transparency.faq_harmful_a: Olostep's customers are vetted AI and business intelligence companies using publicly available data for legitimate purposes. Olostep has strict terms of service prohibiting illegal or harmful use. If any customer violates these terms, they are immediately terminated. Additionally, we only access publicly available information—the same content anyone can view in a web browser.
Transparency.faq_more_q: How do I know you won't add more clients in the future without telling me?
Transparency.faq_more_a: We commit to updating this transparency page whenever we add new approved clients. You'll receive an email notification about any changes, and you can always opt out if you're not comfortable with new partnerships. Transparency is core to our mission.
Transparency.faq_isp_q: Is my internet service provider (ISP) aware of this activity?
Transparency.faq_isp_a: From your ISP's perspective, the traffic looks like normal web browsing. It's encrypted HTTPS traffic to legitimate websites. There's nothing unusual or suspicious about it. Many users already share bandwidth through similar services without any issues.
Transparency.still_questions_desc: We're committed to complete transparency. If you have any concerns or questions about how your bandwidth is used, we're here to help.

ai.seoDescription: Understand the carbon footprint of AI models like ChatGPT, Midjourney, and LLMs. Learn how training and inference contribute to global digital emissions.
ai.intro: Artificial Intelligence offers incredible capabilities, but these systems require massive amounts of energy. From training neural networks to processing millions of daily prompts, AI's carbon footprint is growing rapidly.

trainingVsInference.title: Training vs. Inference
trainingVsInference.body: Training a large language model uses thousands of GPUs running for months, creating a singular massive footprint. However, inference (the everyday use of models like ChatGPT) happens millions of times a day and adds up over time.

hardwareAndCooling.title: Hardware and Cooling
hardwareAndCooling.body: Data centers hosting AI hardware must be kept cool, which often requires significant water and electricity. The overall impact depends heavily on whether the data center runs on renewable energy.

streaming.title: Streaming Carbon Footprint
streaming.seoTitle: Streaming Carbon Footprint: YouTube, Netflix, Spotify | IdleForest
streaming.seoDescription: Compare the carbon emissions of top streaming platforms. Estimate how binge-watching Netflix or listening to Spotify adds to your footprint.
streaming.intro: Streaming video and audio relies on complex networks to deliver high-quality media directly to your device. As resolutions increase, so does the amount of data transferred, which uses more server and network energy.

dataCentersToDevices.title: Data Centers to Devices
dataCentersToDevices.body: Streaming's carbon footprint comes from three main sources: the data centers storing the media, the transmission networks delivering it, and the device you use to watch or listen.

audioVsVideo.title: Audio vs. Video
audioVsVideo.body: Video streaming requires significantly more bandwidth than audio. Watching 4K video consumes considerably more energy and generates more emissions compared to standard definition streaming or listening to music.

digitalCarbonFootprint.title: Digital Carbon Footprint
digitalCarbonFootprint.seoTitle: What is a Digital Carbon Footprint? Definition & Guide | IdleForest
digitalCarbonFootprint.seoDescription: Learn what a digital carbon footprint is and how your internet usage, emails, and Zoom meetings contribute to global carbon emissions.
digitalCarbonFootprint.intro: Every email sent, video watched, and website loaded uses a fraction of electrical energy. While individual actions seem tiny, billions of connected devices and data centers combine to form our global digital carbon footprint.

theInvisibleCloud.title: The Invisible Cloud
theInvisibleCloud.body: When we save files to the cloud, they are actually stored on physical servers in massive data centers. These facilities run 24/7 and consume enormous amounts of electricity.

howCanYouReduceIt.title: How Can You Reduce It?
howCanYouReduceIt.body: You can reduce your digital carbon footprint by keeping devices longer, streaming efficiently, closing unused browser tabs, and turning off video during meetings when appropriate.

page.leaderboard_seo_title: App Carbon Footprint Leaderboard & Rankings | IdleForest
page.leaderboard_seo_desc: Which apps have the highest carbon footprint? Explore the leaderboard comparing digital emissions across AI tools, games, streaming services, and more.
page.leaderboard_desc: Ranked from highest to lowest emissions. Find out which platforms are consuming the most energy and generating the highest levels of CO2 during your daily usage.
